description: Continuous law errors, by case. L/H and N1--N2 form the short panel; N3--N8 form the long panel. The r12 long panel is trained, not unseen-length extrapolation. The original-task TV bar is 0.02; r10 original-law law rows use 0.05 and equal-law rows 0.02. The exact ceiling is zero. r10 law rows are a different all-slots task, not the same denominator as r8/r11--r13 histories. Mean TV is not reconstructed when absent from the saved summary. Analytical reduction only; exact per-cell and per-update rows remain released. Detailed records: paper/data/release/appendix_B_laws.json.gz (schema and SHA-256 in release/index.json).
